ConnectionStrings.//: Set via user secrets or environment variables. Never commit credentials (SOW 3 - Security). Locally: dotnet user-secrets set "ConnectionStrings:DataIntelligenceDb" "<connection string>" --project src\DataIntelligence.Api
ConnectionStrings.//DataIntelligenceDbReadOnly: Optional. A login in the di_ai_readonly role - SELECT on analytics.* only, DENY on sec and ai - that the assistant executes generated SQL as. Leave empty on a Windows-authentication-only instance, where that role has no login to authenticate as; the assistant then reaches the same restricted principal with EXECUTE AS Assistant:ExecuteAsUser. It never falls back to this file's read-write connection.

Assistant.//: ApiKey is never committed. A DeepSeek platform key (sk-...). Set it with: dotnet user-secrets set "Assistant:ApiKey" "<key>" --project src\DataIntelligence.Api
Assistant.//Model: GET https://api.deepseek.com/models lists what a key can reach: deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-pro. Note the id has no vendor prefix - 'deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash' is the OpenRouter spelling and is rejected here.
Assistant.//ExecuteAsUser: Database user switched to before generated SQL runs, used when DataIntelligenceDbReadOnly is empty. Must belong to di_ai_readonly. Created by database-schema.sql section 6.
